rest.search.answers.unknownPath: A path under `/api/v1/products/search` or `/api/v1/products/suggest` that is not exactly one of the two endpoints, a trailing slash included. The body is plain text.
rest.search.answers.methodNotAllowed: Either endpoint, with a method other than `GET`, `HEAD` included. No body; `Allow` names the one method taken. A method the router does not know at all, such as `PROPFIND`, gets the same `405` without `Allow`.
rest.search.answers.indexUnavailable: Either endpoint, when the search engine cannot answer: it is down or slower than the timeout (5 seconds by default), no index has been built yet, or it failed in any way other than refusing the query. After many failures the service stops calling the engine for a minute and answers this at once. Search never answers an outage with an empty result; retry later.
rest.search.searchProducts.summary: Ranked full-text search over the products on sale, with counts by category, merchant and currency, and a statement of how current the index is. The index is a copy of catalog that a sync refreshes, every 30 seconds by default; a category renamed in catalog reaches it at the next sync too. Products of a merchant that may no longer trade stay findable; order's checkout refuses them.
rest.search.searchProducts.who: Anyone. The service reads no token.
rest.search.searchProducts.field.q: Optional. Trimmed, then at most 256 bytes, with no control character (below `0x20`, or `0x7f`), so a tab or a line break is refused. Searched in the title, the category slug and the description, the title counting most, with the engine's prefix and typo tolerance. Blank or absent matches every product.
rest.search.searchProducts.field.categor: Optional and repeatable: `category=pakaian&category=aksesori` matches either. A category `slug`, trimmed, matched exactly apart from case, under the same length and control-character rules as `q`. It may not hold a backtick or a backslash, nor end in `*`. Blank values are dropped.
rest.search.searchProducts.field.sort: Optional. `relevance` (the default), `newest` (most recently changed first, not most recently created) or `price_asc` (cheapest first). Any other value is refused.
rest.search.searchProducts.field.limit: Optional. Hits per page, a whole number: `0` or absent means 24, more than 100 means 100, and a negative number is refused.
rest.search.searchProducts.field.offset: Optional. How many hits to skip, a whole number from `0`, the default; a negative number is refused. For the next page, send the previous `offset` plus `limit`.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.results: The page of hits and the index's freshness. `total` counts every match. A hit's `id` is the product's SKU, which `GET /api/v1/products/{sku}` reads, and `merchant_id` is the merchant's principal. `price_minor` is catalog's list price in minor units (rupiah × 100) when the product was indexed, for ordering only; the price a buyer pays is decided at checkout. `description` and `categories` are left out when empty. `score` is the engine's text-match score, comparable only within one answer. `facets` counts the matches by `categories`, `currency` and `merchant_id`, and is left out when the engine sends no counts. In `index`, `indexed_through_ms` is the time of the latest product change the index holds (`null` while it holds none) and `age_seconds` the time since the last completed sync.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.stale: The last completed sync is older than the service's limit, 10 minutes by default, so `stale` is `true`. The hits are real but may miss recent changes, such as a product withdrawn or a price changed; show them, and say they may be out of date.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.notSynce: Search holds no record of a completed sync: `indexed_through_ms` and `age_seconds` are `null` and `stale` is `true`. Treat the hits as possibly out of date.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.notANumb: `limit` or `offset` is not a whole number. The body does not name the parameter.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.invalid: A parameter breaks its rule: `offset` or `limit` is negative, `q` or a `category` is too long or holds a control character, or `sort` is not one of its three values. The body does not name the parameter.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.category: A `category` holds a backtick or a backslash, or ends in `*`. The engine could not match such a value exactly, so the query is refused rather than answered loosely.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.refused: The engine refused the query as malformed, for example when many `category` values make its query string longer than it accepts. Send fewer values.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.corruptR: A hit in the index carries a product id that search cannot use. Retrying the same query does not help until the index is rebuilt.
rest.search.searchProducts.case.checkpoi: The engine answered, but search could not read its own record of the last sync from its database, so it cannot say how current the hits are and returns none. Retry later.
rest.search.suggestProducts.summary: Suggests distinct product titles for what a buyer has typed so far.
rest.search.suggestProducts.who: Anyone. The service reads no token.
rest.search.suggestProducts.field.q: Optional. The text typed so far. Trimmed, then at most 256 bytes, with no control character. Searched in the title, the category slug and the description, with the engine's prefix and typo tolerance. Blank or absent answers an empty list without asking the engine.
rest.search.suggestProducts.field.limit: Optional. How many hits to draw titles from, a whole number: `0` or absent means 10, more than 100 means 100, and a negative number is refused. Repeated titles are dropped, so fewer may come back.
rest.search.suggestProducts.case.suggest: Distinct titles of matching products on sale, in the engine's order of relevance. A title can come from a product that matched on its category or its description.
rest.search.suggestProducts.case.empty: `q` is blank, or nothing matches. `suggestions` is an empty list, never `null`.
rest.search.suggestProducts.case.invalid: `limit` is negative, or `q` is too long or holds a control character.
rest.search.suggestProducts.case.refused: The engine refused the query as malformed.
